explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 60 named tracks, releases and catalogue references across live September 9–11, 2026 Pitchfork, Resident Advisor and Bandcamp feeds, Shackleton's 2026 Euphoria Bound, Facta's 2025 GULP and Koreless's 2021 Agor; attributed criticism and release metadata only; no audio audition.
exclusions: Run 152 MIZU, Mark Fell and Dopplereffekt decisions, unresolved identities and source windows were not recycled.

Recent Run 140–152 Four Tet, Plaid, JWords, foodman, RRUCCULLA, 96 Back, Gold Panda, Boards of Canada, Theo Parrish, Pole, Kelela, BEAM WONG, MIZU, Mark Fell and Dopplereffekt fields were excluded by repository freshness checks.
Current Bonobo, Argento and Bitchin Bajas material already inspected in persistent history was not recycled.
Tracks supported only by generic genre framing, prestige, process novelty or titles were inspected but excluded.
No Spotify connector, raw audio, audio-feature inference or invented identity was used.

RECENT WINDOW: Facta's 2025 GULP supplies exact descriptions of malformed drum'n'bass reconstruction, twitchy minimal house and tidal bass pressure. https://pitchfork.com/reviews/albums/facta-gulp/

OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE WINDOW: Koreless's 2021 Agor supplies exact descriptions of alternating-speed percussion, a brief house-beat release inside long build-ups and repeated drumless climax withdrawal. https://pitchfork.com/reviews/albums/koreless-agor/
